author: Ingigo
body: Hi there Avicus,  I'm Ingigo and it's very nice to meet you. I haven't been on Avicus and Minecraft for quite a while and I am back. To those I haven't met before, it's nice to meet you and have a fun time on Avicus. You'll have an enjoyable experience along the way. Let's turn this into an AMA, ask away. Nice to meet, Ingigo out.
